title: mason-drift output is a CI contract — extend additively only
body: External CI pipelines consume the 0/1/2 exit codes and the --json shape, and 'stale' there means MAP staleness specifically. Decision drift (2026-07) was added as a parallel computeDecisionDrift with an optional extra JSON key for exactly this reason. Any future staleness source must follow the same pattern: new optional keys, never changed exit-code semantics.

history.note: Imported a legacy record. Prior authorship and review history are unknown.

inspections.note: Inspected src/decisions/drift.ts and src/drift/cli.ts. Local anchor paths now join the existing decision-drift file list.
